Well in black and white you have to actually pay really close attention to shadows and where the light falls. In color it’s actually a nice effect (in my non professional opinion) to have a soft light or shadow fall on your subject, in fact I really love the look of that. In B/W where the light falls will be where the eye is drawn, so you have to ensure the subject itself is well lit etc. That’s probably a horrible explanation of it but that’s what I’ve got 😂

Pretty much you need to be thinking of black and white when you are shooting, not just adding it as an after thought in editing.

It gets covered in soot and thinks the pilot light is out and automatically shuts off your gas supply to protect you from gas building up. If this is what it is in your case too, just remove the sensor and clean it with light grit sand paper back to clean brass and replace it. Hopefully this gets you warm again and saves a service call. 
I'm no expert.. but something to try. Worked for me.

op.author: cornerstone
op.body:
Yes. Me too. Lol

Not the same triggers... mine is random sharp noises. (slamming doors, random hammering, sudden unexpected yelling... ect.) Usually a little annoying at first leading to, well, anger by the eighth or tenth time in under an hour! 
I found earphones INVALUABLE!
Believe it or not, I found EDM music very enjoyable and serves to block out most of what makes me crazy. (counter intuitive... but I figure MY issue is the randomness of the annoying sound.) I like EDM and it is very predictable. It's ALL ABOUT rhythm! Lol) When I feel the frustration getting the better of me and the world doesn't seem to want to let up... I throw on the earphones and I'm back to happy place in under 5 minutes! Lol Perhaps it could work for you? Just an idea that might get you to an island of peace? :)

Don't panic on price. I have two great pairs I would never give up. They were both 2-300'ish range. (Audio-technica 50x closed and Sennheiser  HD558 open). And my point... I have a pair of Sony ear buds I picked up at a Grocery store 17.99 on sale for 10 bucks and they work almost as well! (they travel with me always!)

Thanks for bringing more light to a very little known issue some of us are dealing with. Everyone tells me "that's just the world going on... don't let it bother you so much... " but they don't hear it from our perspective.

May you find peace some how... :)

Fantastic plan! I hope you can stick to it. I love that you ditched the TV. I haven't had TV for close to 5 years now. When I go to other peoples houses now, they have it on all the time like it's the family fireplace. It feels so chaotic just being there and they don't even notice. I enjoy coming home again where I can think and relax! It really demonstrates to me what a source of "uptightness and frustration" can be cut out of our lives simply by turning off the damb tube! Lol

Something for your curiosity to indulge! :)
